source_title: 'Iran Too Strong For America?': US Ally Drops Bombshell On Trump; 'He Can't Win This War...' - The Times of India
source_excerpt: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has delivered a blunt message on the US-Israel war against Iran, saying the conflict cannot be won militarily and must end through diplomacy. Speaking in Seoul, Merz warned that further military escalation would not resolve the crisis and stressed that Germany was stepping up diplomatic efforts to end the fighting. His remarks come as the war continues to take a heavy economic toll on Europe, with energy costs and disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz putting pressure on businesses and consumers. Iran's Mohsen Rezaei has also hit back at European governments, accusing them of supporting US and Israeli military actions while complaining about the economic consequences of the war.
